OH2-a.rule: 0 wrong results, 0 tensor-error CSRs, 0 not-ok among all checked launches, every band, both cards

OH2-b.rule: per kernel metric: |median(hot 80-85 C) / median(rest B0) - 1| <= 0.1 % PASS; else hot median inside the rest band's range PASS (within noise); else FAIL

OH2-c.rule: the heater's implied clock (cycles / host wall time of each 0.5 s launch), median per 5 C band of the die mean, in 0.5994-0.5995 GHz

OH2-d.rule: windows inside a heater (ALL32/ALL24) launch: max dhot <= +4 in every band; median(80-85) - median(60-70) in [0, +1]

dhot_all_windows_note: descriptive: every ok 1 s window of the OH-2 blocks (heating, batteries, holds, tail), by the window's mean

OH2-e.rule: memprobe's refresh period (jittered series, as MEM-P5) at the hot band = 2,325.4 +- 0.1 minion cycles
